item.title: Fairfax County Police launch 'Drone as First Responder' program to improve 911 response times
item.description: Fairfax County Police have launched a Drone as First Responder program designed to improve emergency response and real-time situational awareness.

item.title: Person struck by Metro train at Brookland station; Red Line service disrupted
item.description: A person was struck by a Metro train at Brookland station, causing Red Line delays, single-tracking and shuttle bus service.

item.title: Montgomery County animal shelter at 'critical capacity' for large dogs, urgent adoptions needed
item.description: Montgomery County Animal Services says it is at critical capacity for large dogs and urgently needs adopters and foster families.

item.description: A battle is brewing between the city of Alexandria and homeowners in one of its long-established neighborhoods. item.title: Enhanced juvenile curfew in effect this weekend for Navy Yard, U Street corridor
item.description: D.C. has once again put special curfew zones in place as officials try to get ahead of large teen gatherings this weekend.The curfews in Navy Yard and the U Street corridor went into effect at 8 p.m. on Friday and last until 11 p.m. The same goes for Saturday and Sunday.
